name: Trina
notes: The female counterpart voice of the same Slip-N-Slide bass-rap crossover, and the parameter that separates her file from Trick Daddy's is the hook. The research says R&B-leaning hooks add a ii–V or VI–VII lift over otherwise one-chord vamps, so the chord block carries both of those as real families beside the static i, `extensions.seventh` climbs to 0.26, and `scales` picks up dorian. The melodic material is sampled soul chops or a 2-bar synth motif with the sung guest hook carrying the line, which is why the melody is the busiest of the three Miami entries here — `densityPerBar` [3, 8] with an arch/descend contour rather than a flat stab riff — and why the counter leans on `bell_echo`. `session.halfTime` is false and the claps are on 2 and 4, as the Miami-bass configuration requires; the 808 tom rolls are the `tom`/`shaker` perc pair. ⚠ `confidence` is low. The research rates the entry medium-low, sources only the era and the lane, and marks the 92–104 straight band [LOW-CONF]; **every number in this file is lane inference**, the tempo most of all. ⚠ Two things the research names have no parameter and are recorded only here: the *snap/clap hybrid on 3* that the later records add — this model keeps the 2-and-4 backbeat throughout — and the *synth bass doubling the 808 an octave up on sung hooks*, which is a layer rather than a second part, so the 808 keeps the `bassline` role and no `bassline` block is authored. ⚠ Fill fingerprint for this batch: `gapProb` 0.36 / `descendProb` 0.46 / `rampJitter` 10. ⛔ `session.scales` **widens** its parent's set rather than narrowing it: `dorian` is not one of crunk's four, and the convention elsewhere is that an artist narrows its genre's scales and never reaches outside them. It is here for the R&B lift the research names on the hooks, which is a ii–V figure and reads flat in natural minor. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts.
